title: ROC analysis: AUC with a DeLong interval and a Youden threshold
summary: The area under the ROC curve of a continuous marker, its DeLong confidence interval, and the threshold maximizing Youden's index.

sizing._note: Sized on the precision of sensitivity and specificity at the intended threshold, or on the AUC's interval width (Hanley-McNeil).

pinned_defaults: Direction pinned: higher values mean disease (pROC direction = '<'); pROC's default 'auto' flips a marker that points the wrong way into a good one.
DeLong interval on the AUC scale (ci.auc method = 'delong'); Python writes out the placement-value variance.
Youden threshold among midpoints of consecutive observed values (pROC coords, best.method = 'youden').
_threshold: A threshold chosen on the data is optimistic: over 100 seeds the Youden index at the chosen threshold exceeds the true maximum by 0.015 on average. Prespecify or validate a threshold for use.
